shortDescription: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc TSE:9502:

children: CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC: WITHDRAWAL OF APPLICATIONS FOR PERMITS AND APPROVALS FOR UNITS 3 AND 4 OF HAMAOKA NUCLEAR POWER STATION AND RELATED APPLICATIONS

CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC: COMPANY RESOLVED TO WITHDRAW APPLICATIONS FOR PERMITS TO AMEND REACTOR INSTALLATION LICENSES FOR UNITS 3 AND 4 OF HAMAOKA NUCLEAR POWER STATION AND RELATED APPLICATIONS, ALL OF WHICH WERE SUBMITTED IN CONNECTION WITH NEW REGULATORY STANDARDS
CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC: IMPACT OF MATTER ON COMPANY'S CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR CURRENT FISCAL YEAR AND FUTURE PERIODS HAS NOT YET BEEN DETERMINED

CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER CO INC: DETERMINED THAT, GIVEN SERIOUS DOUBTS THAT HAVE ARISEN REGARDING RELIABILITY OF APPLICATION DOCUMENTS AND COMPANY'S SUBSEQUENT HANDLING OF MATTERS IN REVIEW PROCESS, IT WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE TO MAINTAIN EXISTING APPLICATIONS
